collection.title: Audi Coupe 1988 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1988 to 1995 version of an Audi Coupe requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Coupe which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
